description: Commit 22 — New request wizard at /dashboard/hospital/requests/new. A 4-step client wizard (blood group → urgency + units → location → review) that calls a createBloodRequest server action and redirects to the new request's detail page. Depends on FEAT-001 (hospitalRequestApi.createRequest must exist).
steps: 1. Edit src/lib/validations.ts: add `bloodRequestWizardSchema` using zod: `z.object({ bloodGroup: z.enum(BLOOD_GROUPS as [BloodGroup, ...BloodGroup[]], { error: 'Choose the blood group needed.' }), urgency: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(5, 'Choose urgency.'), units: z.coerce.number().int().min(1, 'At least 1 unit.').max(10, 'Max 10 units.'), location: z.string().trim().min(3, 'Add a hospital, area or landmark.').max(120, 'Keep it under 120 characters.'), lat: z.number().min(-90).max(90).nullable().optional(), lng: z.number().min(-180).max(180).nullable().optional() })`. Export `BloodRequestWizardValues = z.infer<typeof bloodRequestWizardSchema>`. Add `requestWizardSteps: (keyof BloodRequestWizardValues)[][] = [['bloodGroup'], ['urgency', 'units'], ['location', 'lat', 'lng'], []]` — step 4 is review-only with no validated fields.

2. Create src/app/actions/hospital.ts: add `"use server"` at top. Import `revalidatePath` from next/cache, `redirect` from next/navigation, `api, API_URL, ApiError` from `@/lib/api`, `getSession` from `@/lib/session`, `bloodRequestWizardSchema, hospitalEditSchema` from `@/lib/validations`. Implement `hospitalToken()` helper (same pattern as `donorToken()` in donor.ts, but checks `role !== 'HOSPITAL'` and redirects to `/auth/login?next=/dashboard/hospital`). Implement `createBloodRequest(values: BloodRequestWizardValues)` — parse with schema, call `hospitalRequestApi.createRequest(token, { bloodGroup, unitsNeeded: units, urgency, lat: lat ?? undefined, lng: lng ?? undefined })`, `revalidatePath('/dashboard/hospital/requests', 'layout')`, return `{ ok: true, id: result.id }` or `{ error: messageFor(e) }`. Note: location is a UI-only field for the wizard display — it maps to the hospital's own address; the backend derives location from the hospital profile, so do NOT send `location` to the API. Add a `const messageFor` helper identical to the one in donor.ts.

3. Create src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/new/page.tsx: thin server page. Import `getSession`, `Eyebrow`, `NewRequestWizard`. Render: `<Eyebrow>New request</Eyebrow>` + h1 'Post a blood request' + `<NewRequestWizard />`. Add metadata `{ title: 'New blood request' }`. Max-width constraint: `<div className='max-w-xl space-y-6'>`.
4. Create src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/new/loading.tsx: export default Loading() returning `<FormSkeleton fields={3} />`.

5. Create src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/new/new-request-wizard.tsx: `"use client"`. Imports: `useState, useTransition`, `useForm, useWatch` from react-hook-form, `zodResolver`, `ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Check, LocateFixed, MapPin` from lucide-react, `toast` from sonner, `useRouter` from next/navigation, `createBloodRequest` from `@/app/actions/hospital`, `Button` from `@/components/ui/button`, `FieldError, Input, Label` from `@/components/ui/input`, `Spinner` from `@/components/ui/spinner`, `BLOOD_GROUPS, bloodGroupLabel` from `@/lib/blood`, `cn` from `@/lib/cn`, `bloodRequestWizardSchema, requestWizardSteps, BloodRequestWizardValues` from `@/lib/validations`. State: `step` (0-3), `pending` via `useTransition`. Form: `useForm<BloodRequestWizardValues>({ resolver: zodResolver(bloodRequestWizardSchema), defaultValues: { units: 2, urgency: 3 } })`. Watch: `bloodGroup`, `urgency`, `units`, `lat`. Step 0: blood group — 8 buttons in grid-cols-4, same aria-pressed pattern as ProfileForm. Step 1: urgency — 4 card-style buttons (Critical urgency=5, Severe urgency=4, Urgent urgency=3, Standard urgency=1) styled like SummaryWizard urgency options + units range slider with live count display. Step 2: location text input (required) + optional geolocation button (same pattern as ProfileForm: rounds to 3dp, toast success/error). Step 3: review — read-only summary card showing blood group, urgency label, units, location. Navigation: Back/Continue pattern from RegisterForm and SummaryWizard. On final step submit: call `createBloodRequest(values)`, on `{ ok: true, id }` call `router.push('/dashboard/hospital/requests/' + id)`, on `{ error }` call `toast.error(...)`. Progress bar: spans for each of 4 steps.
6. Commit: `git add src/lib/validations.ts src/app/actions/hospital.ts src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/new/` && `git commit -m 'feat: add new request wizard'`
acceptance_criteria: src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/new/new-request-wizard.tsx exists as a client component with 4-step wizard
src/app/actions/hospital.ts exists with createBloodRequest server action
bloodRequestWizardSchema exported from src/lib/validations.ts with correct fields
requestWizardSteps array is exported from src/lib/validations.ts
findings: 1. BloodRequestWizardInput vs BloodRequestWizardValues: bloodRequestWizardSchema uses z.coerce.number() for urgency and units, so the schema has an input type (unknown/string) and output type (number). Both types are exported: BloodRequestWizardInput (z.input) for useForm's TFieldValues generic, BloodRequestWizardValues (z.output) for the transform generic. The wizard uses useForm<BloodRequestWizardInput, unknown, BloodRequestWizardValues>. FEAT-003/004 should follow the same pattern if they use coerce fields. 2. hospitalToken() is defined in src/app/actions/hospital.ts and checks role === 'HOSPITAL', redirecting to /auth/login?next=/dashboard/hospital. FEAT-003 and FEAT-004 server actions in the same file can reuse this helper. 3. The new request wizard routes to /dashboard/hospital/requests/:id on success — FEAT-003 must implement this page at src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/[id]/page.tsx. 4. Unused Zap icon: the Zap icon is imported from lucide-react in the wizard for the Severe urgency option — this is intentional and was used in the component. 5. hospitalEditSchema is not yet defined in validations.ts — FEAT-004 must add it when implementing the hospital profile edit form.
